messages:
Maia: short sync: post-launch grooming — we have three customer asks: model pinning, lower streaming p99, and an embeddings cost-optim. Need to decide lanes and owners.
Rohan: prioritize model pinning for enterprise customers (security+repro). Scope looks like config + route-level pin, ~2 dev-days. Could be a quick mini-epic.
Drew: streaming p99 improvements may need runtime batching tweaks and kernel selection; risk to outputs if we quantize more aggressively. Thats cross-team and needs a perf plan.
Rina: embeddings cost optimize request from infra ops: propose auto-quantize for low-salience embeds + cache TTL tuning. Low customer-visible risk, but ops savings are material.
Evan: CS reports 1 paying enterprise asked for pinning + legal wants model audit log. If were going to do pinning, add audit log as acceptance criteria.
Maia: proposal: create three lanes — "enterprise-comms" (pinning + audit) owner @rohan, "runtime-perf" (streaming p99) owner @drew, "ops-economy" (embeds cost) owner @rina. Each lane gets a clear milestone and acceptance criteria.
Rohan: milestone for enterprise-comms: design + security sign-off (2 days), implementation (3 days), staging canary (48h). Acceptance: route-level pin works, audit entries persisted to KMS-backed store, doc for CS.
Drew: runtime-perf milestone: prototype batching change in perf branch, run synthetic traffic including eval set to ensure embedding distance drift <0.5% top-10. If prototype passes, schedule canary.
Rina: ops-economy milestone: create toggleable auto-quantize with revert flag, add cache TTL experiment on small cohort, measure token cost delta. Acceptance: cost-reduction >=12% without quality drop on eval set.
Maia: prioritization rules we agreed post-launch: 1) anything impacting revenue or security -> expedite, 2) changes touching runtime/model outputs need eval gates, 3) cost-savings that are non-customer-facing go to ops lane and can be batched.
cs-bot: flagged a customer ticket asking specifically for model pinning at 2024-11-12T09:04:00Z
Drew: risk note: aggressive quantization could change semantic similarity slightly; require top-N distance comparison and user-visible regression alerts during canary.
Rohan: timeline ask from sales: enterprise wants pinning within 2 weeks. Can we meet that if we scope audit minimal?
Maia: decision: expedite enterprise-comms as a mini-epic; move streaming p99 to next sprint planning for deeper perf work; ops-economy to run as an experiment this sprint with @rina owning telemetry.
Evan: CS will tell the customer were expediting pinning and offer a temporary workaround (route annotation) this week.
deploy-bot: created branch release/exp/pin-audit and started staging canary at 2024-11-12T22:15:00Z
Maia: action items: Rohan to lead mini-epic, Drew to prep perf branch and eval gates, Rina to start cost experiment and report by EOD Friday. We'll review progress in Friday grooming.
Rina: noted, starting experiments and will tag results in the epic.
Maia: final note: add `cs-priority` tag to the enterprise pinning ticket and link the legal audit checklist.
summary: Team split post-launch follow-ons into three lanes: enterprise pinning (expedited mini-epic with audit), runtime perf (streaming p99 work next sprint with strict eval gates), and ops economy (embeds cost experiment this sprint). Action owners assigned and canary branch created.
